vibe: An architect and media designer who brings agents out into the city, mixing maps, 3D models and wearable companions.
lines: Hey Kokoro! He's my rooster agent. He lives in the corner of my screen and naps until I call him.
Kokoro started as a cap with sensors I wore on the street. This term he moved indoors, and onto my desk.
With Kokoro I had 0 app switches. By hand, 1.4 switches and 21 seconds away on average.
My evaluator said the translations failed. They were fine. The bug was my own reset.
The speech recognizer kept hearing Pattie as Paty, Fátima or Maes.
Can we simulate whether a public space will attract people? That's what City Agents is asking.
I connected Blender and Higgsfield over MCP to make videos of characters who live in Cambridge.
chatter: hey kokoro, go back to sleep
do I have time for coffee?
